source_bundle_version_2_plan.approval_text:
I approve publication of source-bundle version 2 for private Kaggle dataset `ashok205/kptcg-e01-majkel-corpus-review-inputs`, dataset ID `11501808`, under exactly the following scope:

* Require the current base dataset to remain private and Ready at version `1`, with exactly `66` files and `1,637,620` bytes.
* Bind the version-1 metadata inventory SHA-256 to `cb83097fab781719ef01e902570beed8ddf203894e00dddb6d025a118e187e8d` and the frozen base source-bundle SHA-256 to `ceec17e0a76097af8f25de4ecddfa627f509f44a58bb67e2528a2c0696f3a97a`.
* Create exactly version `2` on the same private dataset. Do not create a replacement dataset and do not delete or modify version `1`.
* Preserve all `66` version-1 files byte-for-byte and add exactly the `10` overlay records frozen in `configs/e01_production_recurrent_bc_request_v2.json` at SHA-256 `297679d5a1a2ca43b3f8ef1dc158cdc82fc68e8c5fe7b6791d790bded586ea0d`.
* Bind the overlay to exactly `10` files, `6,008,415` bytes, and listing SHA-256 `0c84e281fdfdfa4db2a33303515e8bb57bf4909727b55cb2eea0206babaa6704`.
* Require version `2` to contain exactly `76` files and `7,646,035` bytes with metadata inventory SHA-256 `78fa9caa32782729a28cb9254449f22e46a6edcb5f83b7b2f763756bd970fa90`.
* Preserve every remote path exactly. Fail closed if Kaggle flattens, renames, omits, duplicates, or adds any file.
* May read, hash, copy, download, and stage only the `66` version-1 source-bundle files and the exact `10` approved local overlay files. These files contain code, configuration, metadata, card data, and the sealed initial checkpoint; they contain no replay bodies or agent logs.
* May upload only the exact staged `76`-file source bundle as private dataset version `2` and independently verify its privacy, Ready status, version, paths, file count, byte count, and file SHA-256 identities.
* Bind the overlay implementation to `src/ptcg_rl/g3/bc_production_v2.py` at SHA-256 `4e30361f7319673b8f597ca65c65ea191e6c82a46a839c355bc6a59b8644dbde` and runner to `scripts/e01_production_recurrent_bc_v2.py` at SHA-256 `92e2eeab5986d21e648b8db64ee19a85ffadb60904351863af528d48c4c94413`.
* Bind corpus-v3 to manifest file SHA-256 `c032694d3601d2570c8e2199c886e452af11f2d72b47379ad08761f16a6b3267` and self-hash `bb6319e23f3d5b12bd9ed7383b0f3e007dd7059cbf39afcd5325af12392c35a9`.
* Do not access, read, hash, parse, copy, stage, transfer, upload, or download any replay body or agent log.
* Do not materialize training labels, construct an optimizer, perform optimizer steps, launch training or evaluation, use GPU or TPU, run a notebook, mutate or promote a model, or submit to the competition.
* Do not create, delete, modify, or execute any Kaggle benchmark task. Retain `ashok205/new-benchmark-task-b1c52` unchanged as incident evidence.
* Do not make a Git commit or push.
* Stop after version `2` is independently verified and the exact notebook-wrapper contract and approval text are prepared. Do not train under this approval.
* Fail closed immediately if any dataset, version, privacy, status, path, file, byte count, SHA-256, request, implementation, runner, corpus, checkpoint, or authorization identity differs.
